alt: Craft supplies on a dark grey surface with a dotted pattern, including pink paper, rolled orange and magenta strips, an orange segmented pie chart, an orange square with a white capital P, and a green measuring grid in the corner.
caption: A paper craft setup with a pie chart and the letter P on a dark patterned surface.
description: This tabletop arrangement features pieces of colored paper, including a pink sheet and rolled tubes in magenta and orange. An orange circle divided into segments forms a pie chart, over which a small orange square card with a white letter P is placed. A green cutting mat with measurement markings is visible in the bottom corner.
